answers.question: restaurant Thai Wok: no opening hours
answers.answer: Jernhusen lists 'JA Thai Wok' at Flemingsberg station: Mo-Fr 10:00-20:00; Sa,Su 11:00-20:00. The chain's own site (jathai.se) shows only its Hornsgatan restaurant, so Jernhusen is the source.

open: No current station plan found from SL, Jernhusen or Huddinge; the 2020 Huddinge study predates recent changes, and lifts/escalators per platform are confirmed only by OSM.
Signposted names of the bridge level and entrance halls: none found.
Taxi stand: OSM has a taxi node ~170 m away; no owner source gives its position.
